title: Evaluation of minterm leaves
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $v,x : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The AND gate whose inputs are the minterm leaves specified by $v$, evaluated after the input-negation gates have been run on $x$, has value equal to the Boolean indicator of the equality $x=v$.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ and $x$ are Boolean assignments on $n$ variables
